legal_privacy_s1:
Astrology Atlas collects the following data to provide its services:
- Email address (for account creation and sign-in)
- Profile information (name, date of birth, place of birth, zodiac sign — voluntarily provided by the user)
- Usage data (analysis history, streak information)
- Device information (platform, language preference)
legal_privacy_s2:
Collected data is used for the following purposes:
- Providing personalized astrology analyses
- Managing and securing your account
- Improving the app experience
- Fulfilling legal obligations
legal_privacy_s3: Your data is stored encrypted on Firebase (Google Cloud) infrastructure. Profile information is also kept in your device's local storage. Only you can access your data.
legal_privacy_s4:
The following third-party services are used:
- Firebase Authentication (sign-in/sign-up)
- Firebase Firestore (data storage)
- OpenAI API (AI-powered analysis generation)
- RevenueCat (subscription management)

These services are subject to their own privacy policies.
legal_privacy_s5: The app does not use cookies. User preferences (theme, language, profile) are stored in the browser's local storage (localStorage) and are not shared with third parties.
legal_privacy_s6:
Users have the following rights:
- View and export their data (Settings > Export Data)
- Delete their data (Settings > Delete All Data)
- Permanently delete their account (Settings > Delete Account)
- Request information about data processing
legal_privacy_s7: For questions about this privacy policy, reach us at destek@astrolojiatlasi.com.
legal_terms_s1: Astrology Atlas is a platform offering AI-powered astrology analysis, horoscope readings, numerology, dream interpretation, and other spiritual content. Content is for entertainment and personal growth purposes and does not replace professional advice.
legal_terms_s2:
- You must be at least 13 years old to use the service.
- You are responsible for the security of your account.
- You may not use the app for illegal purposes.
- You must avoid behavior that negatively affects other users' experience.
legal_terms_s3:
AI-powered readings provided by Astrology Atlas are for entertainment and general information purposes. These readings:
- Are not medical, legal, financial, or psychological advice
- Should not be used as the sole reference in your decision-making
- Do not claim scientific certainty
legal_terms_s4:
- Premium subscription provides access to advanced tools.
- Subscriptions renew automatically.
- Cancellation is done through the App Store or Google Play.
- Refund policy is subject to the respective store rules.
legal_terms_s5: The app design, logo, content structure, and code belong to Astrology Atlas. Users have the right to share their personal analyses but may not copy or distribute the app itself.
legal_terms_s6: Astrology Atlas does not guarantee that the content provided is accurate or complete. The app is provided "as is." No liability is accepted for decisions made based on the content.
legal_terms_s7: These terms of service may be updated without prior notice. Updated terms will be accessible within the app.
legal_kvkk_s1: Under the Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK), the data controller is Astrology Atlas.
legal_kvkk_s2:
- Identity information: Name, email address
- Birth information: Date of birth, birth time range, place of birth (voluntary)
- Astrological information: Zodiac sign, rising sign, moon sign (voluntary)
- Usage data: Analysis history, app usage statistics
- Technical data: Device type, language preference, IP address
legal_kvkk_s3:
Your personal data is processed for the following purposes:
- Execution of membership processes (performance of contract)
- Personalized content delivery (explicit consent)
- Ensuring app security (legitimate interest)
- Fulfilling legal obligations (legal requirement)
legal_kvkk_s4:
Your personal data may be transferred to the following parties:
- Firebase/Google Cloud (data storage — US-based)
- OpenAI (AI analysis — US-based)
- RevenueCat (subscription management — US-based)

Transfer is based on your explicit consent under KVKK Article 9.
legal_kvkk_s5:
Under Article 11 of KVKK, you have the following rights:
- Learn whether your personal data is being processed
- Request information if it has been processed
- Learn the purpose of processing and whether it is used accordingly
- Know the third parties to whom it is transferred domestically or abroad
- Request correction if processed incompletely or incorrectly
- Request deletion or destruction under KVKK Article 7
- Object to results arising from automated analysis against you
legal_kvkk_s6: To exercise your rights under KVKK, you can send an email to destek@astrolojiatlasi.com. Your requests will be answered within 30 days at the latest.
